section_summary: This section consists chiefly of consular telegrams reporting Japanese merchant vessel movements in May 1941, followed by copies paraphrased for the U.S. Navy. It also records cargo and passenger details, arrangements to monitor and limit ships’ fuel and water supplies in the Philippines and British-controlled ports, and correspondence about who should report vessel movements from Australia.

subfiles.title: Norway Maru at Manzanillo
subfiles.about: Reports Norway Maru’s cargo exchange at Manzanillo and departure for Corinto.
subfiles.summary: Norway Maru arrived from Los Angeles, discharged 144 tons, loaded 46 tons, and sailed for Corinto.

subfiles.title: Yokohama vessel sailings
subfiles.about: Reports Goyo, France Maru and Nitiran sailings.
subfiles.summary: Goyo and France Maru sailed May 11; Nitiran was reported bound for Batavia.

subfiles.title: Yokohama sailings for Navy
subfiles.about: Restates departures of France Maru, Goyo and Nitiran.
subfiles.summary: Lists routes to Manila, California and Batavia.

subfiles.title: Scotia and Amarylis at Auckland
subfiles.about: Reports Scotia’s arrival and Amarylis’s departure at Auckland.
subfiles.summary: Describes Scotia as Norwegian and Amarylis as Japanese; the latter identification is corrected on page 281.

subfiles.title: Auckland movements for Navy
subfiles.about: Copies Cox’s Scotia and Amarylis report.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the Auckland arrivals and departures.

subfiles.title: Tankers and Ryusai depart Japan
subfiles.about: Reports Itukusima, Nisshin and Ryusai departures.
subfiles.summary: The tankers sailed for California; Ryusai sailed for the Philippines.

subfiles.title: Tanker departures for Navy
subfiles.about: Restates May 12 departures for California and the Philippines.
subfiles.summary: Names Nisshin, Itukusima and Ryusai.

subfiles.title: Departures from Moji and Miike
subfiles.about: Reports Teiyo Maru and four other ships leaving for California or the Philippines.
subfiles.summary: Gives owners, destinations and tonnages for Teiyo, Kurohime, Kotohira, Kasyu and Malta Maru.

subfiles.title: Moji and Miike departures for Navy
subfiles.about: Restates the Teiyo Maru and Philippine-bound ship departures.
subfiles.summary: Lists routes and tonnages of five vessels.

subfiles.title: Hoyo Maru naval personnel
subfiles.about: Reports a Japanese Navy-chartered tanker bound for California.
subfiles.summary: Hoyo Maru was to leave Kure for Estero Bay to load fuel; its crew list included 15 naval personnel.

subfiles.title: Hoyo Maru report for Navy
subfiles.about: Restates Hoyo Maru’s charter, fuel mission and naval crew.
subfiles.summary: Reports two commissioned officers and 13 seamen aboard.

subfiles.title: Kobe bills of health
subfiles.about: Lists bills of health issued to Goyo, Nitta and Naruto.
subfiles.summary: Records their planned routes to San Francisco, Manila and Balboa.

subfiles.title: Kobe health bills for Navy
subfiles.about: Restates bills of health for three Japanese vessels.
subfiles.summary: Names Nitta Maru, Goyo and Naruto Maru with destinations.

subfiles.title: Further Kobe bills of health
subfiles.about: Lists bills of health for Tatsuta, Asuka, Kiyosumi and Amagisan.
subfiles.summary: Their intended routes reach Hawaii, California, New York and the Philippines.

subfiles.title: Kobe clearances for Navy
subfiles.about: Restates routes for Asuka, Amagisan, Tatsuta and Kiyosumi.
subfiles.summary: Lists the four vessels’ intended destinations.

subfiles.title: Otowasan and Husimi sail
subfiles.about: Reports May 13 sailings for California, Singapore and Bombay.
subfiles.summary: Otowasan sailed for San Pedro; Husimi was reported bound for Singapore and Bombay.

subfiles.title: Otowasan and Husimi for Navy
subfiles.about: Restates the Otowasan and Husimi sailings.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the destinations of both ships.

subfiles.title: Akasisan and Tyoko sail
subfiles.about: Reports sailings to Bangkok and Melbourne.
subfiles.summary: Akasisan and Tyoko reportedly sailed May 14.

subfiles.title: Akasisan and Tyoko for Navy
subfiles.about: Restates Akasisan and Tyoko destinations.
subfiles.summary: Tyoko sailed for Melbourne and Akasisan for Bangkok.

subfiles.title: Buccaneer and Sydney arrivals
subfiles.about: Reports Japanese ship arrivals at Sydney and Nouméa.
subfiles.summary: Buccaneer arrived from Yokohama; Sydney arrived at Nouméa from Rabaul.

subfiles.title: Philippine ship supply monitoring
subfiles.about: Reports voluntary monitoring and possible limits on ships’ oil, water and coal supplies.
subfiles.summary: Major suppliers agreed to monthly reports, alerts about abnormal orders and voluntary limits if requested. Sayre identifies the principal oil companies and says no suspicious orders have appeared. Naval intelligence and neutrality offices will cooperate.

subfiles.title: Philippine supply report paraphrase
subfiles.about: Restates Philippine arrangements for reporting and limiting ship supplies.
subfiles.summary: Oil and water suppliers will report monthly and flag unusual orders. The paraphrase also describes controls from company offices abroad and scarce oil at Shanghai.

subfiles.title: British bunker restrictions
subfiles.about: Describes British and Netherlands East Indies limits on bunker deliveries to Japanese ships.
subfiles.summary: Fuel deliveries are limited to the next port of call, allowing ships to be delayed and reducing fuel available to raiders.

subfiles.title: Instruction to consul at Singapore
subfiles.about: Advises that satisfactory adjustments have been made in the Philippines.
subfiles.summary: Responds to the consul’s March 19 telegram.

subfiles.title: Assessment of Philippine supply controls
subfiles.about: Assesses Sayre’s voluntary reporting and supply-limitation arrangements.
subfiles.summary: Davis judges further restrictions unnecessary for now and recommends sending the attached informational telegram to Singapore.

subfiles.title: Arabia Maru at Santos
subfiles.about: Reports Arabia Maru’s arrival from Osaka and departure toward Buenos Aires.
subfiles.summary: The ship left Santos via Montevideo.

subfiles.title: Arabia Maru report for Navy
subfiles.about: Restates Arabia Maru’s Santos movements.
subfiles.summary: Reports its May 15 arrival and May 17 departure.

subfiles.title: Tonnan Maru No. 2 documentation
subfiles.about: Reports a tanker’s departure without a health bill or crew-list visa.
subfiles.summary: The consulate authenticated a deratization certificate after Tonnan Maru No. 2 left Kobe for Los Angeles to load fuel.

subfiles.title: Tonnan Maru No. 2 for Navy
subfiles.about: Restates Tonnan Maru No. 2’s documentation and departure.
subfiles.summary: Reports departure for Los Angeles without a crew-list visa or health bill.

subfiles.title: Florida Maru cargo at Corinto
subfiles.about: Details cargo discharged and loaded by Florida Maru at Corinto.
subfiles.summary: Florida Maru discharged cement, flour, asphalt, machinery and other goods; it loaded cotton, cottonseed and lignum vitae for Japan.

subfiles.title: Kenyo, Milan and Himalaya sail
subfiles.about: Reports May 16 departures for San Francisco, Singapore and Calcutta.
subfiles.summary: Kenyo is identified as a tanker.

subfiles.title: May 16 sailings for Navy
subfiles.about: Restates Kenyo, Milan and Himalaya destinations.
subfiles.summary: Lists all three May 16 sailings.

subfiles.title: Six Yokohama sailings
subfiles.about: Reports May 15 departures with detailed American and Asian routes.
subfiles.summary: Asuka and Naruto had multistop routes through the Americas; Tatsuta, Kazuura, Nagato and Samarang had other destinations.

subfiles.title: May 15 sailings for Navy
subfiles.about: Restates routes of six vessels leaving or reportedly leaving May 15.
subfiles.summary: Provides detailed port calls for Asuka and Naruto and destinations for the remaining ships.

subfiles.title: Request to verify Amarylis flag
subfiles.about: Asks whether Amarylis is Panamanian rather than Japanese.
subfiles.summary: The inquiry was requested by a Navy Department lieutenant.

subfiles.title: Takaoka Maru at Buenaventura
subfiles.about: Reports a freighter’s route through Buenaventura.
subfiles.summary: Takaoka Maru arrived and departed May 18 for Callao and Valparaíso, carrying no passengers.

subfiles.title: Buenaventura movement for Navy
subfiles.about: Restates the Japanese freighter’s Buenaventura call and onward route.
subfiles.summary: Gives prior calls from Kobe through Balboa and onward destinations.

subfiles.title: Amarylis flag corrected
subfiles.about: Corrects Amarylis’s flag and reports Scotia’s departure.
subfiles.summary: Naval authorities confirmed Amarylis was Panamanian; Norwegian Scotia cleared Auckland for Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Sydney at Auckland
subfiles.about: Reports Sydney’s arrival from Nouméa.
subfiles.summary: The Japanese vessel would call at other New Zealand ports.

subfiles.title: Sydney arrival for Navy
subfiles.about: Copies the report of Sydney’s Auckland arrival.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the Nouméa origin and planned New Zealand calls.

subfiles.title: Yawata and Amagisan sail
subfiles.about: Reports sailings to Manila and Shanghai.
subfiles.summary: Yawata sailed May 17; Amagisan sailed May 18 via Los Angeles and the Panama Canal.

subfiles.title: Yawata and Amagisan for Navy
subfiles.about: Restates Yawata’s and Amagisan’s sailings.
subfiles.summary: Gives dates and destinations for both vessels.

subfiles.title: Grace Line cover letter
subfiles.about: Forwards a memorandum on Japanese ships in South America.
subfiles.summary: Says the information had already been supplied to State Department officials.

subfiles.title: Cargo lifted from Peru and Chile
subfiles.about: Tabulates Japanese ships, cargo tonnages and service changes.
subfiles.summary: Lists cotton, ores, copper, nitrate and wool lifted in early 1941, with vessel characteristics and scheduled sailings. It argues Japanese services increased in capacity and speed.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment to Patchin
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the cargo list covering Peru and Chile.
subfiles.summary: Thanks Patchin for supplying the list.

subfiles.title: Reporting Japanese vessel movements from Australia
subfiles.about: Proposes direct naval attaché reporting of Japanese vessel movements.
subfiles.summary: Minter says Commander Causey now receives information from the Australian Navy and can transmit it in Navy code. Consular officers would cease duplicate reporting unless instructed otherwise.

subfiles.title: Despatch forwarded to Navy
subfiles.about: Forwards Minter’s despatch on vessel movement reporting.
subfiles.summary: Encloses the April 10 Canberra despatch for Navy information.

subfiles.title: Uncertainty over Australian reporting
subfiles.about: Requests instructions on consular and naval attaché responsibilities for ship reports.
subfiles.summary: A Navy message expands requested reports to foreign merchant ships other than British vessels and asks consuls and the attaché to cooperate. Minter explains that consuls lack access to the Australian Naval Board, while Causey has arranged to receive its reports. He asks the Department to settle who should collect and transmit the information.

subfiles.title: Kogyo leaves Sydney
subfiles.about: Reports Kogyo’s departure from Sydney for Yokohama.
subfiles.summary: The Japanese vessel departed May 22.

subfiles.title: Ginyo Maru at Manzanillo
subfiles.about: Details Ginyo Maru’s cargo, passengers and onward voyage.
subfiles.summary: Ginyo Maru arrived from Los Angeles, discharged cargo, loaded antimony and sailed for Balboa. The telegram counts passengers disembarking and in transit.

subfiles.title: Ginyo Maru report for Navy
subfiles.about: Restates Ginyo Maru’s Manzanillo call.
subfiles.summary: Records antimony loading, passenger movements and departure for Balboa.

subfiles.title: KirIsima, Tonan and Clyde sail
subfiles.about: Reports May 20 sailings toward U.S. ports and Batavia.
subfiles.summary: KirIsima headed for Atlantic and Gulf ports; tanker Tonan Maru No. 2 for Los Angeles; Clyde Maru for Batavia.

subfiles.title: May 20 sailings for Navy
subfiles.about: Restates routes of KirIsima, Tonan Maru No. 2 and Clyde Maru.
subfiles.summary: Separates confirmed and reported May 20 sailings.

subfiles.title: Tokai, San Luis and Mexico sail
subfiles.about: Reports three Japanese vessels departing May 21.
subfiles.summary: Tokai headed toward New York, San Luis toward San Francisco, and Mexico Maru toward Manila and Davao.

subfiles.title: May 21 sailings for Navy
subfiles.about: Restates the Tokai, San Luis and Mexico Maru routes.
subfiles.summary: Lists destinations for all three ships.

subfiles.title: Kamakura and Lisbon Maru sail
subfiles.about: Reports May 22 sailings for Manila and Calcutta.
subfiles.summary: Kamakura departed for Manila; Lisbon Maru was reported bound for Calcutta.

subfiles.title: Kamakura and Lisbon for Navy
subfiles.about: Restates the two May 22 departures.
subfiles.summary: Gives Manila and Calcutta as destinations.

subfiles.title: Health bills for Chile and Atlantic
subfiles.about: Reports bills of health for two Philippine-bound Japanese ships.
subfiles.summary: Chile was bound for Calambayanga and Atlantic for Legazpi.

subfiles.title: Chile and Atlantic for Navy
subfiles.about: Restates anticipated departures of Chile and Atlantic.
subfiles.summary: Lists their Philippine destinations.

subfiles.title: Yamagiri Maru leaves Buenos Aires
subfiles.about: Reports Yamagiri Maru’s departure toward Kobe.
subfiles.summary: The steamer arrived May 11 and departed May 24 via Santos, Panama and Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Yamagiri Maru report for Navy
subfiles.about: Restates Yamagiri Maru’s Buenos Aires movements.
subfiles.summary: Reports arrival and the route toward Kobe.

subfiles.title: Nagasaki and Miike departures
subfiles.about: Reports four vessels sailing for Oregon or the Philippines.
subfiles.summary: KoEi and Ganges Maru sailed from Nagasaki; Kyokko and Konzan Maru sailed from Miike.

subfiles.title: Four departures for Navy
subfiles.about: Restates Kyokko, Ganges, Konzan and Koei Maru sailings.
subfiles.summary: Gives their departure dates, ports and destinations.

subfiles.title: Norway Maru leaves Puntarenas
subfiles.about: Reports Norway Maru’s departure for Balboa and South American ports.
subfiles.summary: The OCR gives an impossible May 34 date; the accompanying paraphrase says May 24.

subfiles.title: Norway Maru report for Navy
subfiles.about: Restates Norway Maru’s departure from Puntarenas.
subfiles.summary: Dates the departure May 24 and gives Balboa and South America as destinations.

subfiles.title: Kanto Maru at Santos
subfiles.about: Reports Kanto Maru’s Santos call and route to Japan.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived May 22 from Rio de Janeiro and was sailing via Rio, Panama and Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Kanto Maru report for Navy
subfiles.about: Restates Kanto Maru’s arrival and onward route.
subfiles.summary: Reports its Santos arrival and planned passage to Los Angeles and Japan.

subfiles.title: Takaoka Maru at Peru
subfiles.about: Reports Takaoka Maru’s arrival and departure in Peru.
subfiles.summary: The vessel arrived from Kobe May 25 and sailed the same day for Mollendo and Valparaíso.

subfiles.title: Arabia Maru leaves Buenos Aires
subfiles.about: Reports Arabia Maru’s departure for Los Angeles.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived May 21 and sailed May 26 via Brazilian ports and the Panama Canal.

subfiles.title: Arabia Maru report for Navy
subfiles.about: Restates Arabia Maru’s Buenos Aires call.
subfiles.summary: Gives arrival date and route toward Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Kurama Maru at Durban
subfiles.about: Reports Kurama Maru’s arrival and planned route to Los Angeles.
subfiles.summary: The steamer arrived from Lourenço Marques and was bound via southern African, South American and Panama Canal ports.

subfiles.title: Kurama Maru report for Navy
subfiles.about: Restates Kurama Maru’s Durban arrival and May 28 departure plan.
subfiles.summary: Lists its route through the Cape, South America and Panama.

subfiles.title: Huzisan and Yamahagi sail
subfiles.about: Reports a tanker sailing to California and another ship to New Caledonia.
subfiles.summary: Huzisan sailed May 23 for San Luis; Yamahagi was reported bound for Nouméa.

subfiles.title: Huzisan and Yamahagi for Navy
subfiles.about: Restates the May 23 Huzisan and Yamahagi departures.
subfiles.summary: Gives San Luis and Nouméa as destinations.
